about: Issue #402, change 1c: every fact the narrator's fact blocks tagged `from` "result" or "line" in the kept long hauls of rounds 5 to 10 (355 — the scorecards' own count), each labelled right or wrong to keep as what its tag claims: the dice's, or the player's line's. `floor`: what the module did with it — refused (kept as the narrator's colour) or kept (bound; the scorecards count 12 of these 'not found', a restatement or a discarded draft). `rolled`: the beat was a move whose dice were rolled. Labelled by four readers on one rubric, a sample of 32 checked by hand; the counts are in docs/decisions.md, issue #402 change 1c. One row a tagged fact, in the order the runs recorded them (a step with two narrations has both).
rubric: result: right when the fact states what the dice decided — the outcome and the stakes line it delivered, or the oracle's answer — and nothing more; wrong when it adds a name, a count, an object, what someone says or wants, a new complication or cost, or the narration's colour. line: right when the player's line says it; wrong when it adds someone's response, an outcome or a detail the line did not give.
